Email from Katherine Celeste Urbina Barillas, Purchasing Specialist, CMI Alimentos, to Todd Vahlsing. Subject: RE: Pollo Campero RFP Submission Confirmation. Received September 7, 2026 at 9:19 AM.

Katherine confirmed receipt of the Global Payments proposal and pricing submission. Pollo Campero is still working with IT to obtain model numbers for existing indoor and drive-thru screens and the inventory list for equipment stored at its warehouse. Katherine will share the information when available so the Global Payments team can review it and update or supplement the proposal if needed.
